notes: TWO-PART. Stage one is a per-position logistic on P(pts <= 0) over the whole rostered population, C by season-grouped CV on log loss. Stage two is ridge for E[ratio | played] plus pinball-loss quantile heads at 7 levels, fitted on PLAYED weeks only. The published p10/p50/p90 are the MIXTURE's, so p10 is exactly 0 wherever the zero probability exceeds 0.10 -- which a pooled quantile fit cannot say at all. K and DST are two intercepts: this table carries no kicking or defensive usage columns. Zero weeks (pts <= 0) are 28.2% of the training rows.
